nature_language: 当前位置广州。我和我的两个朋友想去深圳玩两天，预算2100人民币，住两间双床房，坐地铁游玩，想吃海鲜，想去深圳欢乐谷玩。
nature_language_en: Current location: Guangzhou. My two friends and I want to go to Shenzhen for two days. Our budget is 2,100 RMB. We plan to stay in two twin-bed rooms, travel around by metro, eat seafood, and visit Shenzhen Happy Valley.
